title: The SAUERKRAUT transposable element accelerates Arabidopsis floral transition
authors: Dongus JA; Tang YH; van Driel AD; Schon MA; Pleunis ET; Duijts K; Debnath J; Koevoets IT; Kokkinopoulou P; de Zeeuw T; Ortega S; Meyer AJ; Blok AM; Boesten R; Testerink C
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拟南芥转座子SKRT通过影响IBA稳态调控盐胁迫下开花时间，涉及基因表达与DNA甲基化，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Salt stress alters plant development, including the floral transition, but regulation of timing of flowering by salt is poorly understood at the molecular level. To identify genetic loci regulating the floral transition under high soil salinity, we performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) in Arabidopsis thaliana and identified natural variation at the UGT74E1-UGT74E2-BT3 ( UUB ) locus that correlates with bolting time specifically in response to salt stress. Genetic analysis revealed BT3 as a novel repressor of the floral transition in control conditions. Similarly, the putative IBA glycosylases UGT74E1 & UGT74E2 delay the floral transition in control conditions. Furthermore, we identified that IBA homeostasis regulators TOB1 and ECH2/IBR10 play a key role in the floral transition, and that ECH2/IBR10 are required for the early flowering phenotype of the ugt74e1/ugt74e2 double mutant, indicating that UGT74E1 & UGT74E2 delay flowering by altering IBA homeostasis. A pangenome analysis of the UUB locus revealed variation in the occurrence of the DNA transposon SAUERKRAUT ( SKRT ). CRISPR-mediated SKRT deletion in Col-0 affected gene expression both within and outside the UUB locus and caused a salt-dependent delayed floral transition. The delayed bolting phenotype of the skrt-2 mutant also depends on ECH2/IBR10 function, indicating that SKRT accelerates the floral transition by altering IBA homeostasis. Finally, targeted demethylation of SKRT resulted in delayed floral transition under salt stress. Taken together, our data show a role for SKRT and its DNA methylation levels in the salt-dependent bolting time response in Arabidopsis, revealing a novel molecular mechanism to control flowering in adverse conditions.
abstract_zh: 盐胁迫会改变植物发育过程，包括开花转变，但盐对开花时间调控的分子层面理解尚不充分。为鉴定高土壤盐分条件下调控开花转变的遗传位点，我们在拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）中进行了全基因组关联研究（GWAS），并鉴定出与盐胁迫下抽薹时间特异性相关的UGT74E1-UGT74E2-BT3（UUB）位点的自然变异。遗传分析揭示BT3在对照条件下是开花转变的新型抑制因子。同样，推测的IBA糖基转移酶UGT74E1和UGT74E2在对照条件下延迟开花转变。此外，我们发现IBA稳态调节因子TOB1和ECH2/IBR10在开花转变中发挥关键作用，且ECH2/IBR10是ugt74e1/ugt74e2双突变体早花表型所必需的，表明UGT74E1和UGT74E2通过改变IBA稳态来延迟开花。UUB位点的泛基因组分析揭示了DNA转座子SAUERKRAUT（SKRT）存在与否的变异。在Col-0中通过CRISPR介导的SKRT缺失影响了UUB位点内外的基因表达，并导致盐依赖性开花转变延迟。skrt-2突变体的延迟抽薹表型也依赖于ECH2/IBR10功能，表明SKRT通过改变IBA稳态来加速开花转变。最后，SKRT的靶向去甲基化在盐胁迫下导致开花转变延迟。综合来看，我们的数据表明SKRT及其DNA甲基化水平在拟南芥盐依赖性抽薹时间响应中发挥作用，揭示了一种在不利条件下控制开花的新的分子机制。
